acceptanceCriteria: `corvint-mcp` passes the pinned official 2026-07-28 schema conformance cases (conformance/mcp-2026-07-28) and the run is recorded in docs/BUILD-LOG.md with the schema sha256.

The server exposes the task-context packet and `corvint cem report` output as read-only tools under the same untrusted-data envelope and byte budget as the CLI; no tool mutates repository or trace state (invariant 4).

`mcp-server-unavailable` is removed from the globalDegradations in integrations/compatibility.json only with the conformance receipt cited; adapter rows change only where the receipt covers their tuple.
docs/specs/mcp-server-2026-07-28-v0.md status moves from proposed to accepted for the companion profile with the promotion evidence named; the 1.0 classification table keeps it companion.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the owner's review of JetBrains Air (jetbrains.com/air, JetBrains blog 2026-09-22): the owner accepted the idea for 1.0. Air is a cloud/IDE orchestration platform; only its contracts transfer. Invariant 7 (AGENTS.md) still holds: no hosted service, UI, daemon or network dependency on the local path. Air connects every hosted agent (Claude Agent, Codex, Junie, Copilot, OpenCode) to tools through MCP. Corvint already ships `cmd/corvint-mcp` and `internal/mcp` (docs/specs/mcp-server-2026-07-28-v0.md, proposed/experimental) but integrations/compatibility.json still lists `mcp-server-unavailable` as a global degradation and integrations/README.md names the missing conformed MCP server as one reason every host adapter stays FALLBACK. One conformed server reaches every MCP-speaking host without a per-host adapter. Decision 0373 classifies `corvint-mcp` as a companion: this ticket qualifies the companion and makes no Core or host FULL claim.
title: mcp: qualify `corvint-mcp` as the companion host surface that closes `mcp-server-unavailable`
